body: TYLER multiverse_heroes.md #32 ('The Courier') maps its messenger-between-two-fixed-points framing (eagle at Yggdrasil's crown, Nidhogg at its root) directly onto the arena's two existing ArenaNode positions. W is a pure fixed-geography teleport to whichever node is farther away, distinct from every other hero's ally/foe-relative teleport. Q is a Unicorn-shaped dash-strike that also cleanses The Courier's own debuffs on a landed cast. R is a flat life-drain execute. 7 new headless tests (223 total). Pick-validation bound and draft modulo widened 10 -> 11. Verified live: all 11 hero_ids drafted across a real 22-bot pool after cleaning up a stray leftover-process port conflict, pool left running. REDGARDEN d01eef8.
title: The Courier (Ratatoskr) — eleventh hero, roster 10 -> 11
